scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @bing/server" "npm run dev -w @bing/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bing/shared && npm run build -w @bing/server && npm run build -w @bing/client
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test:agents && npm run test:assets && npm run test:effect-spec && npm run test:release-assets && npm run test:rules && npm run test:turn-timeline
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:ci && npm run test:ui-agents:run
scripts.verify:release: npm run build && npm run verify:release:run
scripts.verify:release:run: npm run test:ci && npm run test:release-assets:dist && npm run test:ui-agents:run && npm run test:ui-agents:submit-ready:run && npm run test:ui-agents:complex:run && npm run test:character-browser:run
scripts.test:ui-agents: npm run build -w @bing/client && npm run test:ui-agents:run
scripts.test:ui-agents:quick: npm run build -w @bing/client && npm run test:ui-agents:quick:run
scripts.test:ui-agents:complex: npm run build -w @bing/client && npm run test:ui-agents:complex:run
scripts.test:ui-agents:reconnect: npm run build -w @bing/client && npm run test:ui-agents:reconnect:run
scripts.test:ui-agents:timeout: npm run build -w @bing/client && npm run test:ui-agents:timeout:run
scripts.test:ui-agents:submit-ready: npm run build -w @bing/client && npm run test:ui-agents:submit-ready:run
scripts.test:ui-agents:focus-fire: npm run build -w @bing/client && npm run test:ui-agents:focus-fire:run
scripts.test:character-browser: npm run build -w @bing/client && npm run test:character-browser:run
